area: Collector console / KPI tiles / period labels
title: "Resolved today" counts a rolling 24 hours, not today: at 14:40 IST it includes cases closed yesterday afternoon
repro: Read code (server check pending): the daily tile label is period1(c) ? "Resolved today" ...; its number is kpiBlock's rc query over scopeWhere(s, now, true) = periodSinceWindow -> `closedAt > (now - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)`.
evidence: PERIODS.daily = { hours: 24, label: "Last 24 hours" } (intel.ts:37); the tile says "Resolved today" (Tamil: இன்று தீர்க்கப்பட்டவை). The same rolling window is called "Last 24 hours" in the period picker and "Resolved this day" in the PDF (reportPdf.ts:91).
cause: The label was written for a calendar day; the window is a rolling 24 h from the console's now.

title: PDF report cover says "District-wide" when the numbers are filtered to a taluk or a category
repro: Set a taluk (map) or a category (chart) filter with no zone, Export report > PDF. The request carries &taluk=/&cat= (Overlays.tsx q()), the server filters every figure (report() -> overview(..., focus)), but buildReport is given scope: c.zoneName ?? "District-wide" and dept only.
evidence: reportPdf.ts:83 prints `${P.label} · ${opt.scope}${opt.dept ? ...}`; buildReport's opt has no taluk or category; the file name stem (Overlays.tsx:237) also leaves them out.
cause: The scope words passed to the PDF were not extended when the taluk and category cross-filters were added.

title: After resolve (or verify/reject) then reopen, a severe unverified incident never returns to 'Severe, not yet checked'
where: src/lib/collector/intel.ts:1166-1169 and :1413-1414 (NOT DECIDED('verify','reject','resolve') over all time)
repro: Open Severe incident in /api/collector/list?status=critical&scope=all; POST /api/collector/decisions resolve (confirmed), then reopen: it is open again (status Open) but absent from the critical list and count. Not run: the 3106 server was not reached before the time box ended; read from code only.
evidence: DECIDED() is EXISTS over every decision, not the latest one with an effect (effective.ts), so a reopen does not undo it.
cause: critical uses 'ever decided' instead of the effective latest decision.
